structured_output.html:
您好！

您的依从性报告 · 2026年05月13日 14:00

⚠️ 需要关注 Hypertension Type 2 diabetes Hyperlipidemia
🤖

AI 健康管家

Hello Margaret! We've been keeping an eye on how you've been doing over the past two weeks, and we want to share a few observations with you. First, the good news: your blood pressure has been pretty steady, and you've been taking most of your medications on time — great job! However, we've noticed your appetite has been lower than usual, and you mentioned feeling nauseous sometimes. This might be related to your metformin — your doctor is aware and may adjust the timing or dosage. Your walking has also slowed down since your knee surgery, which is understandable. We've put together some gentle suggestions and a meal plan that focuses on easy-to-digest, nutrient-rich foods to help you get your strength back. Small steps count!

💚

为什么这些建议适合您

Margaret，您正在从膝关节手术中恢复，同时还要管理高血压和糖尿病。现在的重点是减少恶心、保证一点点营养摄入，并用温和活动帮助身体恢复。
🥩
每餐优先吃几口蛋白质食物
→ 蛋白质能帮助术后组织修复，也能减少活动下降带来的肌肉流失。
🧂
继续保持低盐饮食
→ 您的血压仍在偏高范围，少盐能帮助降压药发挥作用。
🫒
用蒸、煮、炖替代油炸
→ 清淡软烂的食物更适合恶心和食欲下降时入口，也更有利于血脂控制。
💧
少量多次喝温水
→ 补水有助于代谢药物，也可能缓解二甲双胍相关的不适。
📊

依从性概览

💊用药
Mostly on track
问题： Skipped metformin twice due to nausea after meals
调整建议： Consider taking metformin with food or asking your doctor about extended-release formulation
🍽️食欲与饮食
Decreased
可能原因： Likely metformin-related nausea combined with post-surgery fatigue and reduced activity
建议： Try smaller, more frequent meals. Warm soups and soft foods may be easier to tolerate.
🏃运动与活动
Below target
障碍： Knee pain from recent surgery limits walking distance and duration
计划： Start with 10-minute seated exercises twice daily. Add short walks (5 min) as tolerated.
📋健康监测
Needs improvement
缺口： Missed glucose checks on 3 days. Blood pressure monitoring is consistent.
💡

健康建议

Appetite decreased Low activity level Glucose monitoring gaps
💊
把二甲双胍放在吃饭中途服用，不要空腹服药
💬 您最近多次在服药后恶心，随餐中途服用通常能减少胃肠道不适。
🥗
把三餐拆成 5 到 6 次小餐，哪怕只吃几口也算进步
💬 术后恢复期食欲下降时，小餐更容易入口，也有助于糖尿病血糖稳定。
🏃
每天做两次 10 分钟坐姿腿部练习
💬 膝关节置换术后 6 周，温和活动可以减少僵硬并维持肌力。
🏃
状态允许时，在家附近走 5 分钟短距离
💬 轻度步行有助于康复、血压控制和血糖代谢。
📋
设置每日血糖测量提醒
💬 近期漏测血糖会影响医生判断二甲双胍调整后的效果。
评估依据
Margaret's adherence data over 14 days shows a clear pattern: medication compliance is good except for metformin-related nausea, appetite is reduced likely due to the combination of metformin side effects and post-surgery recovery, and activity levels have dropped significantly due to knee pain. The meal plan focuses on easy-to-digest, nutrient-dense options that address all three conditions while being gentle on her stomach.
🥗

营养建议

Margaret, since your appetite is lower right now, focus on nutrient-dense foods in smaller portions. Warm oatmeal, soft-boiled eggs, and broth-based soups are gentle on the stomach. Add a handful of nuts or a small piece of fruit as snacks between meals to keep your energy up.
📋

疾病饮食对照

疾病原则推荐避免
HypertensionLow sodium, high potassiumLeafy greens, bananas, sweet potatoes, fishCanned soups, deli meats, soy sauce, pickles
Type 2 diabetesLow GI, controlled portionsOatmeal, lentils, non-starchy vegetables, nutsWhite bread, sugary drinks, pastries, white rice
HyperlipidemiaLow saturated fat, high fiberSalmon, olive oil, oats, almondsFried foods, butter, fatty meats, full-fat dairy
🍜

您的口味偏好

选择您喜欢的菜系，下次食谱会尽量参考您的口味。

📅

一周营养食谱

✨

饮食小贴士

🍽️Small & frequent
When appetite is low, eat 5-6 small meals rather than 3 large ones. Even a few bites help.
💊Medication timing
Take metformin in the middle of eating (not on an empty stomach) to reduce nausea.
🥣Gentle foods first
Start with warm, soft foods like oatmeal, soups, and eggs when your stomach feels sensitive.
🥤Stay hydrated
Sip water throughout the day. Warm herbal tea can also help with appetite and digestion.
📍

附近推荐

您近期活动量偏低，天气不错时可以去附近公园散散步。
